newsitem.title: USA: Echlin to repay bank debt from unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Echlin to repay bank debt from unit sale.

text.p: Echlin Inc, a maker of motor vehicle parts, said it will repay bank debt with the proceeds from the sale of its Preferred Plastic Sheet Division to Spartech Corp.

Echlin said the sale of the division, which has about $75 million in annual sales, reiterates its commitment to its global automotive operations. Financial terms of the deal were not immediately available.
Preferred Plastic Sheet had become part of Echlin in 1994 through the acquisition of Preferred Technical Group, a maker of automobile hoses, Echlin said in a statement.
The transaction is expected to be completed by August 31, 1997, Echlin said.
It could not be immediately determined whether the company would be posting a gain or a charge from the sale.
